select * from smt_feed_back
and staff_badge LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{query.staffBadge}),'%')
and staff_name LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{query.staffName}),'%')
and staff_phone LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{query.staffPhone}),'%')
and question LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{query.question}),'%')
and status =#{query.status}
and create_time between to_date(#{query.startTime},'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') and to_date(#{query.endTime},'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
order by create_Time desc
